verdict.rationale: Apple's own spec page gives a precise bandwidth figure (546GB/s) for the M4 Max configuration and MLX/Metal docs describe the unified memory architecture, satisfying the bandwidth and memory-type parts of the story. However, no evidence pack item states the M4 Max's memory capacity ceiling (e.g., max GB configurable) — the only capacity figure given (512GB) is for a different chip (M3 Ultra), leaving that part unaddressed. missing for 10: explicit M4 Max maximum unified memory capacity, independent bandwidth benchmark corroboration.
